_doc: iter_015: T87 SPO+ DFL NN + T75 LGB regression ensemble + asymmetric EV gate. LOSO-equiv +40.13 (vs iter_014 +38.28, +1.85). T87 NN was warm-started from T81 weights and fine-tuned with SPO+ Decision-Focused Learning loss (lambda=30, lr=3e-5, ~6-13 epochs). w_nn:w_lgb = 1.0:1.5 from a sweep across {1:0, 0:1, 1:1, 1.5:1, 1:1.5, 2:1, 1:2, 1:0.5, 0.5:1} + 5 three-way blends. thr_up/thr_dn from DE asymmetric on the 10-predictor combined avg over the local 442k test (date 96-119, 5 sym).

horizons._doc: DE LOSO-equiv optimum on 5-NN(T87) + 5-LGB(T75) combined avg (10 predictors). Symmetric fallback k=1.25 (thr=2.5e-4) gives ~+39 (still > iter_014's +38.28).
